annotations.title: Cost of a divorce with property division or of a consumer bankruptcy in Poland, with and without a lawyer

description: Use for the cost of a divorce in Poland (court fees, property division, refund for a divorce without fault) or of a consumer bankruptcy (petition fee, trustee fee), with and without a lawyer at the statutory minimum rates. Give the inputs and the assumptions with the result. The result is a calculation from statutory rates. It is not advice. Calculate the cost of a court case in Poland for one party, without a lawyer and with an advocate or legal adviser at the statutory minimum rates. Case divorce: court fee on the divorce petition (half refunded after a divorce without fault on the joint request), fee on the request to divide the joint property (lower with an agreed division plan), the lawyer minimum rate for the divorce and for the division from the value of the share (half of the joint property; 50% with an agreed request), stamp duty on each power of attorney. Case consumer_bankruptcy: fee on the petition, the lawyer minimum rate for bankruptcy cases, stamp duty and the trustee fee range from the GUS wage. The minimum rate is the amount courts award as legal costs; the fee in the contract with a lawyer may be higher.

division.description: Divorce: none (no division), disputed (no agreed plan, default) or agreed (agreed division plan).

estate.description: Divorce: value of the joint property to divide in PLN, default 400000.

no_fault.description: Divorce without fault on the joint request of the spouses: half of the petition fee is refunded. Default false.
